# Crypto Swaps

> Crypto Swaps is a non-custodial web interface for swapping ETH, USDC, USDT and other major tokens on Ethereum. It routes trades through on-chain DEX liquidity and shows a quote before you sign with your own wallet. It never holds funds or keys.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Crypto Swaps swaps tokens such as ETH, USDC and USDT on the Ethereum network.
- Trades are routed through on-chain DEX liquidity and settle in the user's own wallet.
- The interface is non-custodial: users connect a wallet and sign every transaction.
- Costs are gas paid in native ETH plus price impact and any pool or routing fee shown in the quote.
- ERC-20 sell tokens need a one-time approval; native ETH does not.

## Pages

- Legal: https://crypto-swaps.github.io/legal.html
